tags: Scores higher for pubkeys that actively interact with videos (comments, reactions, zaps) — measures consumption and engagement, not creation.
content:
plan
  comments = do 'nostr.query' {kinds: [1111], authors: [_.targetPubkey], '#K': ['21', '22', '34235', '34236'], limit: 100},
  reactions = do 'nostr.query' {kinds: [7], authors: [_.targetPubkey], '#k': ['21', '22', '34235', '34236'], limit: 100},
  zaps = do 'nostr.query' {kinds: [9735], authors: [_.targetPubkey], '#k': ['21', '22', '34235', '34236'], limit: 100}
in
let
  cList = comments | [],
  rList = reactions | [],
  zList = zaps | [],
  total = length(cList) + length(rList) + length(zList)
in
if total > 50 then 1.0
else if total > 25 then 0.85
else if total > 10 then 0.7
else if total > 5 then 0.5
else if total > 0 then 0.25
else 0.0
